description: This file defines the ResultPaginator class, which implements an iterator for paginating through results of AWS SDK operations, including asynchronous handling and search capabilities.

classes.name: ResultPaginator
classes.description: An iterator class for paginating AWS SDK results asynchronously, supporting search and callback handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the paginator with client, operation, arguments, and configuration.

methods.name: each
methods.description: Runs the paginator asynchronously, applying a callback to each page of results.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns an iterator applying a JMESPath search to each result.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current result or false if invalid.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the current key or null if invalid.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current result is valid, handling pagination logic.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the paginator to the initial state.
